links.outcome: Agreement of LLM preeclampsia risk predictor effects with the validated FMF competing-risks model
links.effect: Composite scores 0.59 to 0.82; directionality preserved up to 90.9% in higher-scoring models; magnitude agreement limited (R2 0.44-0.59); lower-scoring models had frequent sign inconsistencies.
links.quote: Alignment between LLM outputs and the FMF model was heterogeneous, with composite scores ranging from 0.59 to 0.82.

screen.reason: Evaluates the alignment of numerical risk predictions from 8 LLMs against a validated preeclampsia risk model using synthetic perturbation scenarios, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
